title: bcl2fastq
description: Convert bcl files to fastq files using bcl2fastq.

input.help_text: type: `string`, multiple: False, required, direction: `input`, example: `bcl_dir`

sample_sheet.help_text: type: `string`, multiple: False, required, direction: `input`, example: `SampleSheet.csv`

output.help_text: type: `string`, multiple: False, required, direction: `output`, example: `fastq_dir`

ignore_missing.description:
Interpret missing *.bcl files as no call (N), interpret missing control files as not-set
control bits and fill in with zeros when *.stats files are missing.

nextflow input-output arguments.title: Nextflow input-output arguments
nextflow input-output arguments.description: Input/output parameters for Nextflow itself. Please note that both publishDir and publish_dir are supported but at least one has to be configured.
